notes.title: Development Log
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone![/h1]

I see a lot of new people joining us thanks to Steam Next Fest, and I just wanted to give everyone an update on Wrong Number's development so far.

[h1]Achievements Added[/h1]

It's my first time implementing achievements into one of my games. Honestly, I was having a lot of trouble getting it to work, but thanks to a recent Ren'Py update everything has now been fixed and I am so happy with how the achievements run in the game. Woohoo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/8dc4d1a8a1cee73e618fdff86f3b0f1e5017925c.png[/img]

[h1]Final CG Illustration[/h1]

Only one CG illustration is left to do!! 
We'll have a total of nine illustrations (some SFW and some NSFW) in the game's steam release. I am really hoping to add more, depending on how well Wrong Number is received here on steam.
If you haven't yet, consider wishlisting the game and leaving a review! It really helps with the game's development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/08ae3c611f24b9a0794e964d6bb939780b3a51f8.png[/img]

[h1]Release Date?[/h1]

We're waiting to hear back from the Steam Review team, but if everything runs on schedule you can expect Wrong Number is come out on steam in November! I'll update this when I'm certain.
